fields.title: B-01: As Pablo I want to upload my preparation package from the page, several files first and a zip later, so that I need no files on the machine
fields.body:
**Story:** As Pablo I want to upload my preparation package from the page, several files first and a zip later, so that I need no files on the machine

**Acceptance idea:** Pick `.md` or `.txt` files; they replace the package, stay in memory, never written to disk, skipped files named

**Size:** M

**Needs:** B-02; 05 questions Q1 to Q4 (Q5 for zip); 03 UC-07 accepted

**Source:** [UC-07](../03-system-model-and-use-cases/01.7-load-preparation-package.md), [05 01.8](../05-high-level-design-and-architecture/01.8-package-upload-and-vocabulary.md), [01.8.1](../05-high-level-design-and-architecture/01.8.1-upload-limits-and-statements.md)
